_comment: Shot list for episode 15, the fifth of six on sight lost and not given back. 15 new paintings plus the title and close backgrounds (prompts below, generated in this order in Gemini; Brian downloads them in order into images/ep15_the_sound_of_her_feet/). Shared stills: the scroll, Brian's picture, the series picture (site_batch2/15), the woman on the road and the town crying out and Eli at the gate (episode 14), the Euphrates road (episode 11), Henry's study (episode 7), the episode map (maps/ep15.png). Nobody's face is shown: people are seen from behind, far off, in silhouette, or as shapes against the light; Ahijah's face is always lost in shadow. The end of Jeroboam's house is not pictured. Title and close cards get their lettering from make_cards.py (title_card.jpg, close_card.jpg).
style: Painterly oil-sketch look, visible brushwork, warm natural light, the land and buildings of ancient Israel in the time of the early kings unless the prompt says otherwise. No faces shown close up: people are seen from behind or at a distance. No text or lettering anywhere. Calm and hopeful, never frightening or graphic. 16:9.
